statements.t: Our revamped sales and marketing teams are delivering encouraging results, and Project Viking remains on track for completion by the end of the first quarter in 2027.

The Company’s fourth quarter outlook at the midpoint of the guidance ranges reflects expected year-over-year revenue growth driven by ongoing demand across Cellular & Molecular Technology (CMT) and NPI platforms, sequential gross margin expansion, and improving year-over-year profitability on an adjusted EBITDA basis.

The Company is reaffirming its full-year 2026 revenue and gross margin guidance while updating its full-year adjusted EBITDA target to account for higher-than-expected sales of certain lower-margin CMT products and higher revenue contribution from distribution channels and China.
A presentation that will be referenced during the webcast will be posted to the Company’s Investor Relations website shortly before the webcast begins.

The Company has not attempted to provide reconciliations of such forward-looking non-GAAP earnings guidance to the comparable GAAP measure, as permitted by Item 10(e)(1)(i)(B) of Regulation S-K, because the impact and timing of these potential charges or gains is inherently uncertain and difficult to predict and is unavailable without unreasonable efforts.
If these trends described above are prolonged or are more severe than anticipated, our business, results of operations, and cash flow may be materially and adversely impacted.

Building on its gold-standard preclinical foundation, the Company plans to align its portfolio, innovation pipeline, and operating model around four strategic pillars: (1) leading the translational bridge; (2) new product introduction; (3) consumables revenue expansion; and (4) operational excellence and disciplined growth.

In January 2026, the Company developed a comprehensive plan, referred to as Project Viking, for the strategic consolidation of certain of its manufacturing operations to improve efficiency and support long-term growth.

The Company expects the initiative to deliver approximately $3 million in cost savings in 2027, and approximately $4 million in annual cost savings beginning in 2028, while improving throughput and execution.

The Company expects to incur pre-tax restructuring charges related to Project Viking in the range of approximately $4.4 to $5.3 million, including non-cash asset write-off and/or accelerated depreciation charges in the range of approximately $0.6 to $0.7 million, primarily related to the exit of production activities and manufacturing operations at the Holliston, MA site.
The Company expects the initiative to deliver approximately $0.8 to $1.0 million in cost savings in 2027, and approximately $0.3 million in cost savings for the remainder of fiscal year 2026.

During the three months ended September 30, 2026, other operating expenses included $0.3 million of restructuring costs in connection with Project Viking and $0.4 million of restructuring costs in connection with our sales, services and marketing organizations.

During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, other operating expenses included $0.8 million of restructuring costs in connection with Project Viking and $0.4 million of restructuring costs in connection with our sales, services and marketing organizations.

Our expected cash outlays relate primarily to cash interest payments due under our Loan and Security Agreement (the “2025 Loan Agreement”), entered into with certain financial institutions party thereto as lenders and BroadOak Income Fund, L.P., as the administrative agent and collateral agent on December 17, 2025, as well as salaries, inventory, capital expenditures, and other operating costs.

Management has evaluated the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern and considered the Company’s current financial condition, forecasted cash flows, obligations due within the next twelve months, forecasted compliance with the financial covenants under the 2025 Loan Agreement and available sources of liquidity.

estimates.t: There have been no material changes to the critical accounting policies underlying the accompanying Condensed Unaudited Consolidated Financial Statements and as set forth in Part II, Item 7 included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
